values: 持续对敌人造成伤害，期间处于无敌状态。
Satrana deals continuous damage to enemies and is invincible during the effect.
萨忒娜跳起巫舞，对周围2格的敌人造成共240% ATK伤害，期间自身处于无敌状态。
Satrana does the fiery dance, dealing 240% ATK damage to surrounding enemies within 2 tiles. She is invincible during the effect.
本技能的最后一击会魅惑敌人2 + 0.25秒，敌人被魅惑期间仅会使用普通攻击。
The last strike of this skill charms enemies for 2 + 0.25s, making them only use normal attacks while charmed.
对扇形范围的敌人造成伤害，并附带生命汲取。
Satrana attacks enemies within the radius of an arc and gains Life Drain.
爪击面前1格扇形范围内的敌人，造成两次110% ATK伤害，每次附带目标最大生命值2.5% + 0.5%的额外伤害，额外伤害最高不超过萨忒娜75% + 10%的攻击力。本技能造成的伤害还会额外附带100点生命汲取。

Satrana scratches enemies in a 1-tile arc twice. Each strike deals 110% ATK damage plus 2.5% + 0.5% target's max HP. The additional damage cannot exceed 75% + 10% of Satrana's ATK. The damage dealt by this skill grants Satrana 100 Life Drain.
自身及周围的友军攻击敌人会使其被“点燃”，降低受愈并持续受到伤害。
Satrana or allies with Sparks ignite enemies, reducing their Vitality and dealing continuous damage to them.
在战斗开始时使用，使自身2格范围的友军继承火种。敌人累计受到萨忒娜或继承火种的友军造成的3次伤害时，将会被“点燃”，每1秒受到0.8% + 0.2%的最大生命值伤害并降低20点受愈，该伤害最高不超过萨忒娜45% + 5%的攻击力，持续至战斗结束。

Satrana grants Sparks to allies within 2 tiles when a battle starts. When Satrana or allies with Sparks deal damage to an enemy for 3 times, the target is ignited, taking damage equal to 0.8% + 0.2% of max HP every 1s and reducing their Vitality by 20. The skill damage cannot exceed 45% + 5% of Satrana's ATK. The effect lasts until the battle ends.
当所有敌方英雄或累计5名敌方英雄被“点燃”时，降低受愈提升至60点。
When all enemies or a total of 5 enemies have been ignited, the Vitality reduction is increased to 60.
伤害提升至1% + 0.2%的最大生命值。
Increases damage to 1% + 0.2% of the target's max HP.
当所有敌方英雄或累计5名敌方英雄被“点燃”时，伤害提升至2%的最大生命值。
When all enemy heroes or 5 enemy heroes have been ignited, the damage is increased to 2% of max HP.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低12%。
Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低16%。
Reduces damage taken by 16% during battle.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低20%。
Reduces damage taken by 20% during battle.
“点燃”敌人使得自身和友军受到魔法伤害降低。
Satrana ignites enemies, causing her and her allies to take less magic damage.
点燃一名敌方英雄时，自身受到魔法伤害降低16%，持续至战斗结束。每多点燃一名敌方英雄，萨忒娜就会使最近的一名友军获得该效果。
When an enemy hero is ignited, the magic damage taken by Satrana is reduced by 16% until the battle ends. Satrana grants this effect to a nearby ally when one more enemy hero is ignited.
每点燃一名敌方英雄，自身回复200点能量。
Each ignited enemy hero grants Satrana 200 Energy.
受到魔法伤害降低效果提升至20%。
Increases Satrana's magic DMG Reduction to 20%.
受到魔法伤害降低效果提升至22%。
Increases Satrana's magic DMG Reduction to 22%.
所有敌人被“点燃”时，“火狐冲刺”不再拥有冷却时间。
Vixen Rush's cooldown is removed when all enemy heroes have been ignited.
当所有敌方英雄或累计5名敌方英雄被“点燃”时，“火狐冲刺”不再拥有冷却时间。
Vixen Rush's cooldown is removed when all enemy heroes are ignited or when a total of 5 enemy heroes have been ignited.
“点燃”造成的伤害提升100%，并且原“点燃”5名英雄触发的效果将会在“点燃”4名英雄时即可触发。
Increases ignite damage by 100%. The effects that previously required igniting 5 heroes now trigger after igniting 4 heroes.
